image_title: Department of Defense Rate Reduction Data
summary: This table presents data on the Department of Defense (DOD) rate reductions and percent improvements from Fiscal Year (FY) 2002 to FY 2009. The values for FY 02 are as follows: All DOD at 31.5, Army at 29.3, Navy at 39.8, Marines at 73.8, Air Force at 25.6, and Defense Logistics at 25.6. In FY 09, these figures changed to: All DOD at 18.7, Army at 17.8, Navy at 21.2, Marines at 36.7, Air Force at 16.5, and Defense Logistics at 16.9. The rate reductions are noted as: All DOD 12.8, Army 11.5, Navy 18.6, Marines 37.1, Air Force 9.1, and Defense Logistics 8.7. The percent improvements are recorded as: All DOD 41%, Army 39%, Navy 46%, Marines 50%, Air Force 36%, and Defense Logistics 34%.
